font.reason: Loaded with FaRoot. Its neutral UI proportions and genuine variable weights fit the restrained academic feed; Persian joins, ZWNJ, digits and Latin technical tokens have coverage. FA_LH=1.5 gives Persian dots and descenders space.

rtlDecisions.action: Cover the source plate with an opaque text-free paper surface; preserve slot coordinates, expansion and reveal frame thresholds.
rtlDecisions.why: Screenshot text is baked in. Persian DOM replaces visible copy without modifying shared textures or exposing the original underneath arriving cards.

rtlDecisions.action: Right-first RTL flex order; content left=cards[0].x (408), width=cards[0].w (1104), bar height=62. Keep symmetric full-page bar background.
rtlDecisions.why: UI navigation follows Persian reading order. Card-column bounds preserve the original screen framing at zoom 1.35; background width is decoration rather than a text anchor.

rtlDecisions.action: RTL title/subtitle, filter at the left end of the title row. Title block top=88, height=116; FA_LH line boxes.
rtlDecisions.why: Reading order mirrors; sizing recovers the original header vertical footprint and prevents first-beat cropping.

rtlDecisions.what: Date, article count, update metadata and rule
rtlDecisions.action: Metadata at top=86 within title block; rule spans the 1104px column. Date is Persian digits isolated in bdi LTR; primary count at right, update summary at left.
rtlDecisions.why: Metadata must not collide with subtitle glyphs. Column alignment separates update copy from the screen-space counter; dates preserve internal numeric order.

rtlDecisions.what: Paper title, author metadata and ranking/upvotes
rtlDecisions.action: Whole RTL text runs, right-aligned; ranks use isolated #۱ etc., isolated ↑ ۶۳ etc., and رای.
rtlDecisions.why: Paper feed content follows reading order; rank and voting meanings survive the translation. Up arrow is a universal voting symbol and is not reversed.

rtlDecisions.action: Keep arXiv:2607.01001 through .01005 and HuggingFace ↗ in bdi dir=ltr islands.
rtlDecisions.why: IDs retain Latin digits and periods rather than acquiring Persian decimal separators; these are intentional technical/brand tokens. External-link arrow is a conventional symbol.

rtlDecisions.action: Restore خلاصه: prefix; render joined Persian summaries, project names and notes in original fixed card rectangles.
rtlDecisions.why: Static prose is localized without changing arrival beats. No per-character animation occurs in this demo.

rtlDecisions.action: Translate رادار مقاله / از ۳۱ مقالهٔ امروز; mirror right:96 to left:96, align left, mirror scale origin to top left, give rail fixed width 210.
rtlDecisions.why: This auxiliary feed rail belongs on the opposite side of RTL content. Screen-space position and anticipation remain independent of camera tracking.

rtlDecisions.what: Odometer digits, zero and cell geometry
rtlDecisions.action: Use Persian ۱–۹, with Latin 0 only for zero, direction:ltr. Window width=88, lineH=fs(96)*FA_LH=159px; center each digit vertically; preserve 8-frame continuous rolls.
rtlDecisions.why: The original Persian zero was a tiny ring that read as a bullet. The reviewer explicitly allowed an LTR Latin zero. Larger line boxes fit settled Persian glyphs while preserving the source moving-strip clipping effect and all roll beats.

rtlDecisions.what: Card flights, tilts, compression, shadows and camera
rtlDecisions.action: Preserve all source motion expressions, coordinates and keys.
rtlDecisions.why: Gravity, vertical camera follow, depth and alternating tilts are physical; the centered stack does not require horizontal mirroring.

rtlDecisions.action: Nest overlay in actual project-name row (top=0, full row height), right anchor, left trailing border; width grows to 40% of original c.w. Grow/ease remain unchanged; final fade ends at f87 rather than f88.
rtlDecisions.why: Highlight follows RTL text, and actual row geometry prevents covering the note. Source prompt specifically permits tail-card fade compression to clear the shot boundary; the one-frame shortening eliminates the final border remnant.

rtlDecisions.action: Restore همهٔ مقاله‌ها بارگذاری شد, centered at last-card bottom +20 page pixels.
rtlDecisions.why: This source page status was omitted previously. Symmetric center alignment needs no mirroring; it shares camera motion like the original footer.

rtlDecisions.action: Retain right anchor, -14deg rotation and 270deg gradient, and unchanged glaze interpolation/opacity.
rtlDecisions.why: The finishing sweep follows RTL reading flow; horizontal position, decorative tilt and gradient must reverse together.

rtlDecisions.what: Typography and remaining physical style properties
rtlDecisions.action: No Persian letter spacing, uppercase, isolated letter boxes or altered letter motion; symmetric radii and center-center card transform origin remain.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian joining and legibility require whole shaped runs. Symmetric physical geometry and shadows have no reading-direction meaning.

rasterHandling.action: Opaque localized page surface covers the plate; moving cards are Persian DOM replacements. Original files and shared kit/fixtures/textures are read-only and unchanged. No legible baked source text is visible.
rasterHandling.copyScope: Retained existing concise Persian reconstructions of the research subjects, adding source row, ranking/upvote markers, summary prefix, date, filter and footer.

timingException.reason: Source prompt instructs compression of the final highlight at the cut; ensures no border on final frame.

motionFidelity.timingNote: Persian strings remain static; their different lengths do not affect cues or landings. Counter remains 0 through f28, then rolls once per landing and settles at ۵ by f84. Increased digit strip geometry changes travel distance only, not progress/easing/frame timings.

fixes.resolution: Align all header text blocks to card-column x/w; verified complete at f0/f6.
FA_LH, taller title block and distinct metadata row; header rule and update text stay in column.

fixes.issue: Ring zero and short digit cells
fixes.resolution: Recognizable LTR Latin 0, fixed-width/taller digit cells; opening and settled digits inspected.
LTR technical IDs with period, #rank and ↑votes, رای spelling.

fixes.issue: Highlight on note and final border remnant
fixes.resolution: Row-relative tag overlay; last fade ends f87.
Expanded element-level header analysis and this report.
Restored filter, date/count metadata, summary prefix, arXiv/HuggingFace row and all-loaded footer.

visualNotes: Opening brand/title/subtitle are entirely inside frame and header edges match the column.
Subtitle/meta rows are distinct; rule is intact, not partly hidden by slot masks.
Initial zero is an oval numeral. f30/f32 show normal moving odometer clipping, comparable to source; f35/f70/f84/f87 show whole settled Persian glyphs.
Highlight at f30/f32/f35/f70/f84 is on the project-name row and does not cover the note. f87 overlay/border is absent.
All five Persian cards and restored footer are visible at the end; no unintended Chinese or English prose.
Persian joins and lines are intact; technical source tokens are intentionally isolated.

concerns: Existing paper summaries/notes remain concise reconstructions, not a verbatim translation of every raster sentence; an independent reviewer may still require copy expansion.
Counter zero intentionally uses Latin 0 as allowed by the reviewer; other counter/count/ranking digits are Persian, identifiers keep Latin digits.
Odometer glyphs are partially masked during transit as in the original; settled glyphs fit the window.
Public release is not claimed: this report records local fixes and visual evidence for independent review.

lessons.symptom: Rebuilt chrome crops at the first camera zoom and its metadata collides with a screen-space counter.
lessons.cause: Text bounds were derived from the 1920px page instead of the original card-column bounds.
lessons.fix: Use layout card x/w for all content anchors, and inspect both page-space and screen-space elements at the highest zoom.

lessons.symptom: Highlight covers a note rather than the project name after Persian typography changes.
lessons.cause: Fixed percentage-of-card positioning ignores actual translated row geometry.
lessons.fix: Nest the overlay within the project-name row; preserve source width/growth and mirror its inline origin.
